findings.summary: Code shown with only a trailing caption, and the plain <a> warning is stranded after the code instead of stated first.
findings.evidence:
tsx
<Link href="/blog">Blog</Link>
router.push('/blog')
both are soft navigations

findings.summary: One bullet packs two ideas: the old UI stays visible and the loading.js fallback condition.
findings.evidence: Old UI stays visible until the new one is ready or loading.js shows

findings.summary: Code snippets appear before the idea is stated and the Suspense example has no one-line lead-in.
findings.fix: Add a lead-in such as 'Wrap the search-bar client component in Suspense' before the Suspense snippet, and keep the idea bullet directly above each code block.

findings.summary: Bullets hold multiple ideas (static bailout and nearest boundary; server alternatives).
findings.evidence: Server: searchParams prop (Promise, await it) or params

findings.summary: Staleness table row labels mix a config key with page type, and the 'Dynamic' default is ambiguous with the prefetch={true} row.
findings.fix: Use plain labels (Dynamic page, Static page, Dynamic with prefetch={true}) and put config keys in a separate column or the code note.

findings.summary: The router.refresh() bullet mixes what it does, state behaviour and URL behaviour; the stale-cache flow is a text note.
findings.evidence: Keeps client state; URL does not change
findings.fix: Make it a short table or list: refresh() | re-fetches route | keeps client state | URL unchanged.

findings.summary: The section does not cover an outline point (missing "navigation", "viewport").
findings.evidence: Scroll: after navigation Next scrolls to the top of the new page, or to the first element of the segment if it is not in the viewport; <Link scroll={false}> and router.push(url, { scroll: false }) keep position
findings.fix: Add the point with an explanation and an example.

findings.summary: Several bullets hold multiple ideas, and redirect/notFound handling is dense text.
findings.evidence:
Both throw a special error: never inside try/catch
Call after the try block, or rethrow in the catch
Client components: useRouter().push; redirect() is render-only, not event handlers

findings.summary: Search-params loading.js point is stated tersely and code appears before its idea is clear.
